name: acad-files
description: AutoCAD drawing file lifecycle and conversion: open / save / save-as (with chosen DwgVersion) / close the active drawing, import DWG and DXF, export to DXF and downgraded DWG versions, plot the active layout to PDF or DWF via PlotEngine, render images, and run drawing maintenance (purge unused symbols, audit for corruption with optional fix). All operations require the AcadMcp .NET plugin loaded inside an open AutoCAD session.

tools_summary.name: audit_database
tools_summary.description: Run AUDIT on the active document database. Reports the number of errors found and (if fix=true) fixed.

tools_summary.name: close_document
tools_summary.description: Close a document by its file path (or the active document if path is null). Set save=true to save before closing.

tools_summary.name: export_file
tools_summary.description: Export the active document to the given path. Format is one of "DWG", "DXF", "PDF", "DWF", "DWFX", "IMAGE" (PNG). Optional layout name (default: current). Scope is "Display" / "Extents" / "Limits" / "Window" (PDF/DWF only).

tools_summary.name: get_active_document
tools_summary.description: Return descriptor of the currently active document (path, name, modified flag, DWG version, entity count).

tools_summary.name: import_file
tools_summary.description: Import a .dwg / .dxf file into the currently active document at the optional insertion point (default: 0,0,0). DWG files are merged into model space; DXF respects its own units.

tools_summary.name: list_documents
tools_summary.description: List every open AutoCAD document with its file path, modified flag, read-only flag and entity count, plus the active document name.

tools_summary.name: new_document
tools_summary.description: Create a brand new empty document based on the default template (acad.dwt) and make it active.

tools_summary.name: open_document
tools_summary.description: Open an existing .dwg / .dxf file in the AutoCAD UI as a new document and make it active. Optional readOnly flag and password for encrypted DWG.

tools_summary.name: purge_database
tools_summary.description: Run a full database purge: removes every unused symbol-table record (blocks, layers, linetypes, text/dimstyle, mlinestyle, registered apps). Returns the count of records purged.

tools_summary.name: save_document
tools_summary.description: Save the currently active document to its existing path (no-op if it has no path yet — call save_document_as instead).

tools_summary.name: save_document_as
tools_summary.description: Save the currently active document to a new path. Optional dwgVersion is one of "AC1027" (2013), "AC1032" (2018), "AC1024" (2010), etc. Defaults to current AutoCAD's native format.
